- Can you confirm the primary technical owner and the legal/compliance contact for data handling?
- Do you have any hard constraints (UAT windows, blackout dates) in July that would affect a Week‑0 workshop?
- Are the acceptance criteria on page 2 of the MAP doc searchable/clear for your tech team? We can adapt the format.

- July 6–7 (Wed/Thu) — 3 x 90m sessions (tech + security + exec)
- July 13–14 (Tue/Wed) — condensed half‑day + deep ops session

I’ll loop Jasmine and Olga here to suggest edits to the MAP doc after you review. Once we land on owners and dates, I’ll drop a Drive link with an editable copy (we’ll keep a change log).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

I attached a short internal constraints summary — it lists our security checkbox items and preferred meeting windows.

Cheers,

Looping back with a draft edit and proposed owners. I reviewed Marta’s asks and updated the MAP template (copy in Drive will be public edit for the thread). High level changes I recommend: 

- Acceptance criteria table: added an "Observability & Alerting" column with two sample metrics (avg latency p95 and failed response rate > 2% triggers).
- Test scenarios: trimmed to 10 prioritized prompts across clinical summarization and search relevancy (keeps pilot focused).
- Week‑0 agenda: included a 45m security Q&A block for Julia + a 90m tech integration lab.
- Owners: Rodrigo = Tech lead; Julia = Security reviewer; Olga = Redwood enablement; Jasmine = pilot manager.

Draft workshop cadence (compact):
Day 1 (90m): Tech integration lab (Rodrigo + Redwood infra)
Day 2 (90m): Acceptance criteria walkthrough + observability setup + executive alignment (Marta + execs)

Action items I’ll take before workshop:
- Populate the Test Prompts sheet with the 10 scenarios (by Fri 6/25).
- Create an Ops dashboard template for latency/error signals and share as a link.

Ben — I can share the editable Drive copy once Marta confirms which date window. I’ll also add a short change log at the top of the doc.
